usageNotes: Use this to check the subscription status of a specific PBS node registered as a PDM remote — useful for confirming a node is running a valid Proxmox Backup Server license before relying on enterprise features or repository access. Requires `Resource.Audit` on `/resource/{remote}`. The `status` field drives the result: treat anything other than `active` as a license gap requiring attention; `key` and `serverid` may be omitted if the caller lacks sufficient privilege to see them.

examples.summary: Check subscription status for node 'pbs01' on remote 'hetzner-pbs'

tips: The `checktime` field is a Unix timestamp of the last subscription validation check; if it is very stale the node may not have had internet access to validate recently.
A status of 'notfound' (the default) means no subscription key is configured, not that the API call failed.
The `key` and `serverid` fields are only returned when the authenticated principal has sufficient privilege to view them; their absence in the response is not an error.
